Alyac_ReferenceLoader.description: Loads image, video, and audio references with an authoring Prompt and optional H3 Timeline Guides.

image.name: Image
image.tooltip: Managed state for exactly one reference image.

alpha_background.name: Alpha background
alpha_background.tooltip: Fallback color used when compositing alpha.

preview_pixels.name: Preview pixels (MPixel)
preview_pixels.tooltip: Maximum preview resolution; execution media is unchanged.

Alyac_ReferenceLoaderRawOutputs.description: Exposes the enabled media outputs from a Reference Loader bundle.

Alyac_ReferenceLoaderRawPrompt.description: Exposes the compiled prompt from a Reference Loader bundle.

Alyac_ReferenceLoaderStartEndFrames.description: Exposes the first and last enabled image frames from a Reference Loader bundle.

Alyac_ReferenceLoaderOptionsOverride.description: Overrides selected Reference Loader execution options.

Alyac_ReferenceLoaderLLMDescriptionInput.description: Builds ordered image, audio, and video inputs for an LLM description workflow.

Alyac_ReferenceLoaderExportPromptForLLM.description: Exports a Reference Loader prompt and media manifest for an LLM workflow.

Alyac_ReferencePromptCache.description: Caches a prompt using a workflow-persisted Reference Loader fingerprint.

Alyac_PromptLiveCache.description: Caches an editable workflow-persisted prompt while an invalidate key is current.

Alyac_MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideoWrapper.description: Wraps the Reference Loader bundle for MiniMax H3 video generation.
